name: Midcon Cables Company
old_description: Since 1972, Midcon Cables has been an industry-leading cable harness manufacturer specialized in providing high quality, cost effective wiring solutions designed to address the complex electrical performance and packaging requirements of Mil/Aero, industrial and Medical industry applications. Manufactured products and services provided by Midcon include Prototyping and full rate production of Custom/”Built to Print” and molded cable assemblies, RF coaxial connectors/adapters and cable assemblies, Engineering Design and support, product testing and qualification documentation.
about:
Midcon Cables Company was founded in 1972 in North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. The business is employee-owned and operates facilities in both Missouri and South Carolina.

The company manufactures custom and build-to-print cable assemblies, harnesses, and molded interconnects for demanding applications. Its capabilities include cold molding and over-molding per MIL-M-24041, RF coaxial connector and cable assembly termination, fiber optic cable assemblies (single- and multi-mode), and proprietary organized-wiring technologies such as EverFlex and MicroFlex. Engineering design support, qualification testing, and full documentation are provided alongside prototyping and full-rate production.

Midcon serves the aerospace and defense, industrial, and medical markets. Its products are used on aircraft, ground vehicles, missiles, unmanned systems, rotorcraft, ships, and communications platforms. The company also supports commercial customers with value-added wiring solutions.

Midcon differentiates itself with its EverFlex organized-wiring system, which replaces conventional harnesses and flex circuits with a low-profile, robust alternative that integrates controlled circuit positions and tie-downs. A proprietary quick-set potting compound reduces molding cycle times, and the MicroFlex process uses NC machining to produce ultra-flat ribbon assemblies that can incorporate power, signal, RF, and fiber optic lines. The firm holds AS9100 and NADCAP certifications and is recognized as a preferred supplier for its on-time delivery and quality performance.
